remote_observation_method: git ls-remote <repository> refs/heads/main; read only, no fetch/ref mutation

input_data.classification: supplied DATA; original referenced audit ZIP absent
input_data.line_count_convention: 705 logical LF-separated lines, matching nl/sed; 704 newline bytes because the last line is unterminated.

independence: Initial phase independent of current construction/adversary workers; later parent explicitly coordinated snapshots in COORDINATED_SOURCE_RECEIPTS.json. Parent-only progress messages. No other-worker/worktree edits or direct worker exchange.
source_tree_caveat: The first recursive OpenAI root tree response was truncated. A fresh nonrecursive root tree and complete preprints subtree listing replaced it for selective routing; no absence or priority inference used the truncated tree.
receipt_time_caveat: The remote-main observations preceded receipt creation; they are not a fresh remote check at the receipt timestamp.
worktree_mutation_scope: The worker performed read-only git operations; the later worktree HEAD change occurred outside this worker.
